newsitem.title: POLAND: Animex sees 1997 net rising to PLN 20 mln.
newsitem.headline: Animex sees 1997 net rising to PLN 20 mln.

text.p: Polish food trader and producer Animex SA expects to make a net profit of about 20 million zlotys in 1997 after earning 16 million zlotys this year, the firm's marketing director said on Monday.
Animex has netted 13.2 million zlotys over the first 10 months this year and earned 41.5 million zlotys last year after receiving 36 million zlotys in tax refunds.
"Animex expects significant net growth in 1997 from this year, which should be about 20 million zlotys against 16 million zlotys this year," Halina Baltowska told Reuters.
She said the whole Animex group would net 30 million zlotys in 1997 after netting 37.9 million zlotys last year but would not give a forecast for 1996.

Baltowska said the firm's planned purchase of one or two meat firms next year would help Animex gain a 15-percent market share in that sector. She would not say what was Animex's current market share.

She said Animex was currently negotiating with the state treasury to buy a 51-percent stake in meat firm Zaklady Miesne Mazury w Elku and that the deal could be clinched in the first quarter of next year. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
